findings.problem: The hint only rules out erschaffen, so other common words for to create (kreieren, erstellen, erzeugen) also fit, and 'the short word' does not tell them apart because kreieren is just as short.
findings.fix: hint: bring into being, as in creating jobs or making room; not erschaffen, kreieren or erstellen

back.target: to create (to bring into being; Perfekt geschaffen)
back.example: He has created something completely new.

note: In this meaning schaffen is strong (schuf, geschaffen), but in the 'to manage' meaning it is weak (geschafft), so the two cards' Perfekt forms differ, which is worth pointing out to learners.
